PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://w3id.org/serp/brick/reference#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?name ?tsid WHERE {
  ?p a brick:Equipment ; rdfs:label ?name .
  ?p ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsid .
  FILTER(?name IN ("AHU01","AHU03","SupplyFan_AHU02"))
}

PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick/ref#>
SELECT ?p ?class ?tsid WHERE {
  ?p a ?class .
  ?p ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsid .
  FILTER(str(?p) IN ("bldg:AHU01.Electric_Power_Sensor","bldg:AHU03.Electric_Power_Sensor","bldg:SupplyFan_AHU02_Electric_Power_Sensor","bldg:AHU01","bldg:AHU03"))
}
